stories.title: American Airlines plane ‘clipped the wing' of 2nd plane at Reagan National Airport
stories.summary: An American Airlines plane “clipped the wing” of another plane while taxiing at Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport in Arlington, Virginia, on Friday evening, authorities say. No injuries were immediately reported, the Federal Aviation Administration said. “American Airline
